name: Carlon Amoffel
description: A 33-year-old human man and Harper agent, found buried up to his neck in the caravan road.
reuseWhen: Use the supplied card for visual continuity when staging the character.

assets.description: Supplied portrait card for Carlon Amoffel.
Grouped near layer of Carlon buried to his neck, Coppercoil with a flask, and kneeling Lucien. The forehead lettering is a separate editable source overlay composited into this plane.
Carlon’s circular oathbreaker rune stays registered to his forehead in the roadside rescue group.
Lucien listens while the weary Carlon speaks, with the existing oathbreaker rune on his forehead.
Carlon at the reins and Tyjit Skesh holding the caravan at the road shoulder.

appearance.features: Tangled shoulder-length brown hair, stubble, sunburned and dirt-streaked skin, and dark tattoos on his left shoulder and upper arm.
appearance.rescueClothing: Bare chest and feet, a ragged tan waist wrap tied with rope, and a round pendant.
appearance.forehead: A complex circular oathbreaker rune tattooed on his forehead, with interlocking strokes inside the ring.

events.location: Road from Baldur’s Gate to Waterdeep
events.event: Rescued from burial in the road and questioned in Lucien’s wagon.

events.location: Road from Baldur’s Gate to Waterdeep
events.event: Said he broke off an engagement after learning the woman’s family were bandits who expected him to join them. Lucien suspected he was withholding something.

events.location: Road from Baldur’s Gate to Waterdeep
events.event: Volunteered to drive the wagon after the shrieker delay, freeing Lucien to talk about his dreams.
